title: First summary of the survey MERCI LA VAPE. 40,000 responses + 1 health alert - FIVAPE
abstract:
Furthermore, the denigration of vaping and the obvious misinformation of the public, particularly millions of smokers, about the real risk reduction of vaping compared with smoking tobacco and the real benefits of vaping instead of smoking, need to be urgently addressed in view of the smoking rate in France, which is much higher than its European neighbors.  
[>> Download the survey summary](https://fivape.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/SYNTHESE-enquete-Merci-la-vape-2311.pdf)  
The associations AIDUCE, SOVAPE, LA VAPE DU COEUR and FIVAPE, each in their own field, fight against smoking. They advocate harm reduction, a humane approach that is highly appreciated by users. They have no links whatsoever with the tobacco industry, and claim as much in their articles of association and in their actions.
## Does vape help you? SIGN THE PETITION!  
I'm one of the millions of people that vape helps to turn away from tobacco. I want to defend what makes it the most effective aid: the diversity of flavors, affordable cost, objective information on risk reduction.  
**NO to the suppression of aromas**
It's absurd to condemn ex-smokers to tobacco flavors alone, since it's precisely the diversity of flavors that makes the difference.  
that makes smoking cessation easier. The proof: 95% of vapers use at least one other flavor.  
Flavors must remain available within a regulated and controlled framework. The manufacture of e-liquids and their marketing by professionals provide the best guarantees of control for the safety of users.  
**NO to taxes**
Overtaxing a smoking cessation device is unfair.
Neither nicotine substitutes, nor medications, nor hypnosis, nor auriculotherapy, nor quack remedies are overtaxed.  
Taxes should not be a barrier to vaping. VAT on vaping should be reduced to 5.5%, like nicotine substitutes. This would facilitate access to vaping for the most disadvantaged, who are the hardest hit by smoking.  
**STOP denigration**
8 out of 10 French people are unaware that vaping is much less risky than smoking. This perception, which runs counter to scientific knowledge, keeps smokers smoking. The denigration must stop. It discourages vapoteurs and smokers who would otherwise find an anti-smoking solution in vaping.  
**STOP to misinformation**
a non-profit association under the French law of 1901, is involved in reducing the risks associated with smoking tobacco. Its aim is to help all adults in precarious situations by distributing free vaping products (personal vaporizers, e-liquids and accessories). La Vape Du Cœur works in partnership with over 200 healthcare establishments on a daily basis.  
[The Fédération Interprofessionnelle de la vape](https://www.fivape.org/) brings together the entire vaping industry in France, from manufacturers to distributors. The federation's 800 members are independent of the tobacco industry, and account for 70% of the sector's business in France: a specialist organization in harm reduction, and one of France's leading public health players in this field.
